item.title: Long-Term Partnership and Technological Progress in Precision Grinding
item.description:
Enduring Partnership and Advancements in Grinding Technology
#

In 2015, at the Taipei International Machine Tool Show (TIMTOS), Ko-Yen made a significant impression by displaying a red banner that read: “Subverting tradition: One-time processing for multiple-side shaping processing, increasing performance by 50%.” This bold statement was backed by the successful sale of the GJ-400 model showcased at the event, generating considerable momentum for the company.

item.title: From Ocean Resilience to Precision Grinding Innovation
item.description:
From Ocean Resilience to Precision Grinding Innovation
#

President Quan-ji Zhou’s journey began in Qingkunshen, Taiwan, where he was raised in a family dependent on the sea. The unpredictable nature of the ocean instilled in him resilience, keen intuition, and a drive for excellence. Through years of accumulated experience, Zhou refined his expertise in grinding technology, channeling his knowledge into the field of machine manufacturing. This dedication has enabled COMORK to deliver outstanding services to upstream clients and address the evolving demands of the global grinding industry.

item.title: Integrated CNC Grinding Solutions for Precision Manufacturing
item.description:
Advanced CNC Grinding for Multifaceted Precision Work
#

The GJ-400 CNC Hybrid ID & OD Cylindrical Grinding Machine is engineered to streamline complex grinding tasks by combining both internal and external cylindrical grinding capabilities in a single, efficient process. This hybrid approach enables users to perform ID and OD grinding in one clamping, significantly reducing equipment and labor costs while boosting productivity and versatility.

item.title: Precision CNC ID/OD Grinding Solutions for Demanding Industries
item.description:
Advanced CNC ID/OD Grinding for Versatile Applications
#

The GO-350 CNC Hybrid ID & OD Grinder is engineered to deliver high-precision grinding for both inner and outer diameters. Leveraging a robust CNC system, this machine ensures automated, accurate, and efficient grinding operations. Its versatility makes it an excellent fit for industries such as automotive, aerospace, manufacturing, medical, and tool and die sectors.

item.title: Advanced Solutions for Precision Cylindrical Grinding
item.description:
Precision and Versatility in Cylindrical Grinding
#

The GO-354 CNC Cylindrical Grinder is engineered to provide both plunge and angular grinding, supporting a wide range of complex and varied grinding tasks. Its design enables multiple grinding operations within a single setup, reducing machining time and increasing productivity—especially for small and precision components. For larger workpieces, consider the GO-356 CNC cylindrical grinder .

item.title: Precision and Versatility in CNC Cylindrical Grinding
item.description:
Advanced CNC Cylindrical Grinding for Demanding Applications
#

The GO-356 CNC Cylindrical Grinding Machine is engineered for high-precision and versatile grinding tasks. Designed to automate complex processes, it ensures consistent, high-quality results across a wide range of workpieces, including shafts, gears, turbine components, surgical tools, molds, and more. With a distance between centers of 650mm, the GO-356 accommodates larger workpieces compared to the GO-354, making it suitable for demanding industrial requirements.

item.title: Driving Sustainable Manufacturing Through Circular Economy Practices
item.description:
Embracing Circular Economy in Precision Machinery
#

KO-YAN Precision Machinery (COMORK), situated in the heart of Taiwan’s precision machinery cluster, distinguishes itself through a commitment to sustainable manufacturing and circular economy principles. Leveraging over two decades of expertise in precision machining, the company places a strong emphasis on user experience in equipment research and development, offering tangible benefits to the industry.
